visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a medium shot of an East Asian woman with dyed hair and sunglasses resting on her head, wearing a denim shirt; she is laughing and covering her face with her hand. Beside her stands a man of African descent in a grey button-down shirt, gesturing with his hands. The background is a pink wall with some markings and a wooden fence. (2) The camera cuts to the interior of a dimly lit, narrow bathroom with blue and white patterned floor tiles. A white porcelain toilet is visibly broken, with its base detached and lying on its side. There are debris and a blue bucket on the floor. (3) The perspective shifts back outdoors where the man in the grey shirt is seen from behind, walking away toward a red building in a sunny, dusty courtyard. Other people are sitting in the background. (4) The camera returns to a POV-style shot showing the woman's hand holding a keychain with keys. The man in the grey shirt and another man in a tan vest are visible, talking and gesturing toward the woman. (5) The final phase features a handheld selfie shot of the woman and the man in the grey shirt smiling and laughing together. The woman makes a peace sign. They are standing in the same outdoor area with the pink wall and fence behind them.
